interface.title: 浙江省水资源年报查询与导出 (Zhejiang Water Resources Annual Report Query & Export, Hydro Toolkit)
interface.stage_of_work: Data retrieval and checking before analysis: pulling a subset of official annual statistics, checking it for errors, and exporting it for offline work
interface.what_it_is_for: Filter Zhejiang's annual water-resource report tables (water use, water supply, socio-economic indicators) by category, year and prefecture-level city, inspect the county-level rows, and download the result as CSV or Excel.
interface.note: The pinned repository has no app.py; its UI was migrated to FastAPI (see MIGRATED.md). The interface explored here is a Streamlit reconstruction (seed/app.py) built from the repo's src/annual and src/common modules, running on synthetic seed data. Grid behaviours such as sort, column statistics, search, show/hide columns, number format and fullscreen come from Streamlit's standard dataframe toolbar, not from this tool's own code.

data.source: synthetic seed data (bundled with the Streamlit reconstruction; no upload needed)
data.note: The seed data covers only the years 2019, 2022 and 2024 and only two cities: 杭州市 (临安区, 余杭区, 西湖区) and 衢州市 (柯城区, 衢江区, 龙游县). These are limits of the seed data, not of the tool: the README claims 多年数据 2019—2024 for all of Zhejiang's prefecture-level cities. Three categories: 供水量 (surface, groundwater, other, total supply), 用水量 (agricultural, industrial, domestic, ecological, total use) and 社会经济指标 (population in 万人, GDP in 亿元, farmland in 千公顷). Two planted test cases, not properties of any real dataset: 龙游县 2024 总用水量 = 8.7 while its parts add up to 0.87, and its 2024 总供水量 is 0.86; and 龙游县 2022 地区生产总值 is missing (shown as None, written as an empty cell in the CSV).

features.name: Sort-and-statistics data grid for spotting outliers and gaps
features.general: Sort any numeric column to push extreme or missing values to the top, and open a per-column summary (count, empty count, mean, sd, quartiles, histogram) to see whether a column has gaps or outliers
features.specific: Standard Streamlit dataframe behaviour, not this tool's own code. Click a header such as 总用水量 or 地区生产总值_亿元 to sort ascending/descending; missing values show as greyed None; column ⋮ menu → Statistics shows Values, Empty (e.g. 1 (5.6%)), Average, Median, Max etc. plus a histogram
steps: Click a numeric column header to sort ascending, click again for descending
Read the top or bottom rows (e.g. the planted 龙游县 2024 总用水量 8.7)
Look for greyed None cells, which mark missing values and sort to the top
Open the column's ⋮ menu → Statistics to see the empty count and spread
serves_tasks: Find an implausible total among the records

features.name: Table search with result highlighting

screens_never_reached: Years 2020, 2021 and 2023: the seed data offers only 2019, 2022 and 2024 in the 年份 list (screens/008.webp); this is a limit of the seed data, not of the tool, whose README claims 2019—2024
Prefecture-level cities other than 杭州市 and 衢州市: not in the seed data (screens/010.webp); the README claims coverage of all Zhejiang cities
An 'empty selection' warning or no-result state: with no years or no cities selected, the query returned all of them instead (screens/036.webp, screens/040.webp)
not_done: Could not browse continuous 2019-2024 data or other cities: the synthetic seed data holds only 2019, 2022 and 2024 for 杭州市 and 衢州市, so the tool's behaviour on its full real dataset was not seen
The grid toolbar's own 'Download as CSV' button produced no download event when pressed (screens/018.webp). Only the app's 下载 CSV / 下载 Excel buttons were used for export

Could not open the Excel downloads; the reader reports them only as binary files (用水量.xlsx, 供水量.xlsx), so their contents were not checked. The two runs reported different file sizes for 用水量.xlsx, so no size is given
The app has no automatic data-quality check. The planted outlier and missing value were found by hand, by sorting, column statistics and comparing water use with water supply
The column menu items Pin column and Autosize, and the main menu's theme / Rerun / Clear cache / Print / Record screen, were only seen, not tried (screens/028.webp, screens/046.webp)
The external links (GitHub, author) were not followed because they lead off the allowed host
